title: Changing the default writes a "Default changed" row
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop uses COD as the default and makes a term of its own the default instead, and you check the history.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A}, due 14 days after the invoice date.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S12-08 Net 14.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Make Default for New Customers".
  3. Click "Make Default".
  4. Click the "⋯" page menu beside "New Credit Term".
  5. Click "Audit Log".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: the confirmation opens.
  • Step 3: a green success toast shows.
  • Step 4: the menu opens.
  • Step 5: the newest row reads Event "Default changed" and Details "COD → {Term-A}".
